mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate revenue and profit growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decrease in the civilian unemployment rate below 4.0% over two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.0% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling unemployment below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening household demand, which boosts corporate revenue and profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising consumption expenditures (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and economic growth, which reduces corporate earnings and supports negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
